scope: Independent text/contract review of each of the 100 geometry conversations: natural student language, cross-turn references, supported DSL intent, independent mathematical expectations, and distinct family purpose. This is not visual review, audio evaluation, genuine model inference, or app acceptance. Added helper-state assertions require root harness support for geometryOverlay and constructionIncludes; these are contract checks and do not establish rendering.
